title: Venezuelan Score Fat Beef Bowl
description: A tangy and crumbly Venezuelan dish featuring score fat beef, served in a lacquerware bowl, with a unique blend of flavors and textures, low in sodium and adventurous in spirit, incorporating the freshness of hail in its preparation
instructions: Collect and clean the hail, then set it aside to melt slightly, creating a refreshing liquid to be used in the dish.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the score fat beef and cook for 5 minutes, until browned.
Add the cumin, paprika, and salt-free seasoning, and stir to combine.
Add the lime juice and melted hail liquid, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve the score fat beef mixture in a lacquerware bowl, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
